researchDepth: Bounded identity/affirmation/dissonance landscape; ten complete canonical entities and six incident claims. Primary abstracts, selected methods/results and corrections; not a formal systematic review per construct.

entityReviews.constructReview: Behavior incorporated into self-definition, not the behavior, demographic membership or an assigned noun label.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Self-report identity and behavioral frequency/turnout differ; common method and past behavior can explain associations.
entityReviews.timeReview: Canonical weeks/months-years change; brief cue onset does not prove lasting identity content.
entityReviews.unresolved: Voter-wording positive and null field results do not establish independent durable Behavioral Self-Identity change.

entityReviews.constructReview: Current identity accessibility, not enduring importance, fusion or group membership.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Manipulation assignment, self-categorization and independent accessibility measure separate; changed downstream behavior is not a manipulation check.
entityReviews.timeReview: Minutes-hours, potentially reversible; no assumed durable trait effect.
entityReviews.unresolved: No exact salience effect retained from turnout/vigilance alone; cue operation and psychological uptake differ.

entityReviews.constructReview: Enduring centrality of specified identity in overall self-concept, not momentary salience.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Centrality already a component of social-identification profile; shared items/definition could drive REL-PSY-065.
entityReviews.timeReview: Weeks/months-years; generic source lag minutes does not establish rapid durable change.
entityReviews.unresolved: Retype-review proposal for profile→component relation; no automatic noncausal replacement.

entityReviews.constructReview: Cognitive/affective social identification profile, not mere membership, solidarity alone or identity fusion.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Canonical centrality/solidarity/satisfaction/self-stereotyping dimensions; Leach additionally distinguishes group homogeneity. Do not fill/change canonical definition.
entityReviews.timeReview: Enduring profile versus cue salience; repeated measures needed for durable change.
entityReviews.unresolved: Feature-scope architecture issue reused; no uniform profile effect or profile-component causal shortcut.

entityReviews.constructReview: Perceived personal-group oneness; not all identification, actual ties or observed costly behavior.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Verbal/pictorial fusion and sacrifice endorsement differ. New recall experiment measures7item score; reported F inconsistent with reported group means/SD/N.
entityReviews.timeReview: Canonical slow-changing state versus immediate activation score; repeated cross-sectional country changes not within-person persistence.
entityReviews.unresolved: EA0022 RN: reporting reconciliation and state/time-scale alignment required; no invented correction or universal permanent fusion.

entityReviews.constructReview: Clarity, consistency and stability of self-beliefs, not self-esteem or positivity of content.
entityReviews.measurementReview: SCC scale/culture boundaries and breakup-related change differ from independent manipulation; shared negative-report style can confound.
entityReviews.timeReview: Weeks/months-years versus transient certainty; longitudinal breakup not random breakup.
entityReviews.unresolved: No exact self-concept-clarity effect retained; cross-cultural scale interpretation and reverse causality remain.

entityReviews.constructReview: Perceived threat to global adequacy/morality/coherence, not threat to one group or any stress response.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Defensiveness, message acceptance, self-compassion and well-being are not direct identical measures of global integrity threat.
entityReviews.timeReview: Event-specific minutes/hours; downstream educational/health benefits do not establish persistent threat reduction.
entityReviews.unresolved: EA0020 values writing RN; preserve health null and individual/group affirmation differences; PSY-045 revision only.

entityReviews.constructReview: Perceived devaluation/endangerment of a specified identity, not cultural honor norms themselves or global adequacy.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Identity-specific reputation/threat versus vigilance, physiology, belonging and anger need exact alignment.
entityReviews.timeReview: Situational cue/insult before appraisal; regional cultural exposure is not randomized individual norm strength.
entityReviews.unresolved: CUL-055 revision review: insult×regional upbringing not direct randomized community honor-strength effect; F05 anger review reused.

entityReviews.constructReview: Experienced aversive inconsistency/discomfort, not algebraic contradiction or postchoice preference spread alone.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Negative-affect ratings after high-choice statements support scoped discomfort; operational attribution and free-choice measurement artifacts differ.
entityReviews.timeReview: Immediate induced-compliance response versus later attitude change; do not infer mediated path or persistence.
entityReviews.unresolved: EA0021 RN pending full task/measure alignment; positive discomfort retained, artifact critique not universal dissonance rejection.

entityReviews.constructReview: Moral self-definition centrality/internalization, not all moral behavior, displayed virtue or temporary salience.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Internalization versus symbolization and implicit/primed measures differ; self-report studies show larger associations.
entityReviews.timeReview: Canonical enduring centrality; a short moral cue is not enduring trait/identity change.
entityReviews.unresolved: No universal moral-cause effect or causal edge from correlation; cultural/measurement boundaries unresolved.

existingReviews.rationale: Durable collective narrative centrality and an individual's multidimensional identification require realized exposure, interpretation and component specification. Current mediated-segment wording is generic, not an identified mechanism.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Tight/loose culture and explicit dehumanization sources do not test this exact narrative→profile effect.
existingReviews.proposal: Require exact narrative/context exposure, profile component, population/time and source-aligned identification; no shortcut or pathway implementation.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Multidimensional profile/indicator overlap and person→group aggregation still require safeguards.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active records, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged. No existing proposal implementation, causal weights or pathway execution.

existingReviews.rationale: Honor norm culture-level condition can qualify insult responses; region of upbringing is not randomly assigned honor-strength exposure.
existingReviews.nullContrary: SRC286 randomizes insult, not community norm strength; northern/southern male student and reputation scope do not generalize to every identity/person.
existingReviews.proposal: Retain bounded insult/identity-reputation interpretation for review; specify cultural unit, individual exposure and comparison before any exact revision.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Multidimensional profile/indicator overlap and person→group aggregation still require safeguards.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active records, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged. No existing proposal implementation, causal weights or pathway execution.

existingReviews.rationale: Global threat may promote defensive processing, but counterarguing is exact thought count/quality; affirmation→message acceptance does not identify threat→counterarguing.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Health synthesis outcomes, self-compassion experiments and Senegal nulls differ; group affirmation can increase ingroup bias or have nearzero average.
existingReviews.proposal: Require independent threat and counterargument measures, scoped message/affirmation opportunity and timing; no guaranteed defensive thought direction from acceptance outcomes.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Multidimensional profile/indicator overlap and person→group aggregation still require safeguards.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active records, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged. No existing proposal implementation, causal weights or pathway execution.

existingReviews.rationale: Person-level identification and group cooperation prevalence require contribution/opportunity aggregation, not collective-action intent or violent sacrifice.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Umbrella collective action and dehumanization support do not isolate contribution rate; identification dimensions may differ in effects.
existingReviews.proposal: Scope exact contribution behavior, opportunity denominator, group boundary and temporal aggregation; no mediation from named segment or reachability.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Multidimensional profile/indicator overlap and person→group aggregation still require safeguards.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active records, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged. No existing proposal implementation, causal weights or pathway execution.

existingReviews.rationale: Centrality is already a component of PSY-097 profile; same-time profile→centrality may be definitional/measurement overlap rather than independent cause.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Shared items, specification and group target can induce dependence; cited culture/dehumanization sources not exact temporal component mechanism.
existingReviews.proposal: Noncausal/component-boundary review only, replacement predicate unresolved. Do not retype, replace or deactivate current edge.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Multidimensional profile/indicator overlap and person→group aggregation still require safeguards.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active records, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged. No existing proposal implementation, causal weights or pathway execution.

hypotheses.question: Values writing reduces global self-integrity threat.
hypotheses.reason: EA0020 preserves favorable outcomes and null evidence, but direct threat versus proxy/operation alignment unresolved.

hypotheses.question: Self-affirmation equals repeating positive self-statements or generic praise.
hypotheses.reason: Values reflection, personal-pride recall, group affirmation and praise differ materially; no package/component inference.

hypotheses.question: Counterattitudinal statement under high choice increases dissonance magnitude.
hypotheses.reason: EA0021 preserves two experiments, exact full discomfort measure/protocol and replication scope require reconciliation.

hypotheses.question: Postchoice preference spreading proves dissonance.
hypotheses.reason: Selection and noisy repeated ratings can produce apparent spreading without changed preferences.

hypotheses.question: Any inconsistency is psychologically aversive dissonance.
hypotheses.reason: Experienced discomfort, salience and responsibility are not logically entailed by contradictory propositions.

hypotheses.question: Dissonance→attitude change→relief is a transmitted causal pathway.
hypotheses.reason: Timing/order evidence and discomfort ratings alone do not identify pathway-specific effect.

hypotheses.question: Remembering a shared crisis increases fusion.
hypotheses.reason: EA0022 RN due immediate-versus-enduring construct and internal reported-statistic discrepancy; source not silently corrected.

hypotheses.question: War/pandemic occurrence proves within-person permanent fusion.
hypotheses.reason: Repeated cross-sectional means not within-person trajectories; recall experiment not real crisis manipulation.

hypotheses.question: Evolutionary simulation is empirical proof of fusion mechanism.
hypotheses.reason: Mathematical model and empirical study components must remain separate, no graph weights or simulation execution.

hypotheses.question: Identity fusion equals social identification or network ties.
hypotheses.reason: Oneness differs from multidimensional identification and actual interpersonal relations.

hypotheses.question: Collective narratives strengthen identification.
hypotheses.reason: Existing CUL-049 revision path, not duplicate; exposure/component/source alignment unresolved.

hypotheses.question: Social identification causes its centrality by profile definition.
hypotheses.reason: Component contribution cannot be independent simultaneous causal propagation; existing edge retained with retype proposal.

hypotheses.question: Moral Identity Centrality is narrower than general Identity Centrality.
hypotheses.reason: Conceptually plausible typed identity restriction; exact scope/instrument and proposition dedup require review, no formal record.

hypotheses.question: Identity-noun cue changes Behavioral Self-Identity.
hypotheses.reason: Positive/nulled turnout is not independent lasting self-identity; cue/centrality different.

hypotheses.question: A short identity cue permanently changes centrality.
hypotheses.reason: Canonical enduring timescale differs from momentary salience.

hypotheses.question: Behavioral self-identity relates to intention beyond past behavior.
hypotheses.reason: Canonical Rise synthesis predictive/construct distinction; exact causal direction and common-method item overlap unresolved.

hypotheses.question: Relationship dissolution lowers Self-Concept Clarity.
hypotheses.reason: Observed breakup and changes/prediction not randomized dissolution; reverse causality and context remain.

hypotheses.question: Self-concept clarity equals positive self-esteem.
hypotheses.reason: Structural clarity differs from evaluative positivity, and cross-cultural scale meaning differs.

hypotheses.question: Honor norms modify exact identity-threat→anger REL-PSY-046.
hypotheses.reason: Insult×regional grouping not independently identified exact Driver/edge interaction.

hypotheses.question: Gender-composition video increases perceived identity threat.
hypotheses.reason: Vigilance, belonging and desire to participate proxy group-specific threat; men/women differ, exact target still unresolved.

hypotheses.question: Minority membership itself is identity threat or weak identification.
hypotheses.reason: Perceived situation/meaning not demographic category; no identity classification from membership.

hypotheses.question: Avatar appearance changes behavioral self-identity.
hypotheses.reason: Self-objectification/attitude and short embodiment not lasting specified behavior identity.

hypotheses.question: Assigned avatar changes the person's real-world identity by definition.
hypotheses.reason: Representation operation, perceived embodiment and self-definition differ; no NetworkState/AE target loophole.

hypotheses.question: Moral identity relates to prosocial behavior.
hypotheses.reason: Meta-association stronger shared self-report; exact outcome Driver and within-person direction not established.

hypotheses.question: Moral identity causally guarantees moral action.
hypotheses.reason: Priming/implicit contrasts weakest, mixed contexts and shared reports; moral content/situation matter.

hypotheses.question: Identity centrality modifies exact global-threat→counterarguing REL-PSY-045.
hypotheses.reason: Theoretically plausible but no aligned independently identified exact-edge effect extracted.

hypotheses.question: Physiological arousal causes identity fusion.
hypotheses.reason: Fusion theory describes arousal amplifying pro-group action among fused people, not necessarily increasing fusion state.

hypotheses.question: Environmental/institutional exclusion cues change identity salience or threat.
hypotheses.reason: Setting/video composition, representation and realization differ; no whole outside-Family audit or new exact claim.

hypotheses.question: Narrative→identification→centrality is an established pathway.
hypotheses.reason: Existing segment labels do not prove mediation; component overlap and source alignment unresolved.

hypotheses.question: Group affirmation and individual values affirmation have identical effects.
hypotheses.reason: Group norms and self-category can produce different or contrary outcomes, no universal equivalence.
